backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor implementing a single-user manga watchlist with user profiles, manga entry CRUD (add/update/delete/paginate), access control via MixinAuthorization, and blob storage via MixinStorage.
backend/migration.mo: Trivial migration module with no state changes, passing the old actor through unchanged as the new actor.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two features—authentication flow permissiveness and black/gold color scheme enforcement—to their relevant source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Concise per-file summaries of all major frontend source files, documenting correct hook names, import patterns, and styling conventions used across the React app.
frontend/docs/PREDEPLOY_LAYOUT_VERIFICAT: Pre-deployment checklist for verifying layout correctness of AppLayout, MangaListPage, and AddMangaDialog across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
frontend/docs/REBASELINE_FROM_LIVE.md: Documents a rebaseline process aligning the frontend codebase to the live deployment after layout corruption in draft versions 44–45, listing verified files and explicit rules to prevent regression.
frontend/index.css: Empty CSS file at the frontend root level.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with a black-background root div and a module script tag loading the React app from src/main.tsx.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first for static assets, network-first for API/CSS/navigation requests, versioned cache cleanup on activate, and a message handler for manual cache clearing.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root app component that handles authentication state, backend connection, profile loading, and renders AppLayout with MangaListPage or ProfileSetupDialog as appropriate. Also registers the service worker on mount.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginLogout: Button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout, clearing all caches (service worker, IndexedDB manga and cover images) and React Query state on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog shown to newly authenticated users to collect a display name and save their profile via the useSaveCallerUserProfile hook.
frontend/src/components/layout/APP_LAYOU: Manual QA checklist for verifying AppLayout header collapse/expand behavior, sticky positioning, footer placement, and responsive behavior across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main layout shell providing a sticky auto-collapsing header with BookOpen icon, title, and login button, a flex-grow main content area, and a branded footer.
frontend/src/components/manga/ADD_MANGA_: Manual QA checklist for verifying the Add Manga dialog's scrollability, fixed header, viewport constraints, and touch/mouse interaction across small laptop, mobile, tablet, and edge-case scenarios.
frontend/src/components/manga/AddMangaDi: A dialog component for adding a new manga entry with fields for title, alternate titles, synopsis, chapters, rating, genres, and cover images, using the useAddMangaEntry mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/manga/AutoScroll: A component that displays a title text and automatically applies a vertical scroll animation when the content overflows its container, pausing on mouse hover.
frontend/src/components/manga/CoverHover: A draggable portal popup that displays a manga entry's cover image and title (with cycling through alternate titles), centered on mount and closable by clicking outside.
frontend/src/components/manga/CoverImage: A form field component for uploading and managing manga cover images, supporting file upload with progress tracking and removal of existing images.
frontend/src/components/manga/EditMangaD: A dialog component for editing an existing manga entry's fields, pre-populated with current entry data and submitting only changed fields via the useUpdateMangaEntry mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/manga/EditNotesD: A dialog component for editing and saving free-text notes on a manga entry using the useUpdateNotes mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/manga/FloatingCo: A sticky collapsible panel that wraps MangaListControls, displaying filters, sort options, and entry count with a toggle to expand or collapse the controls.
frontend/src/components/manga/GenreCheck: Renders a responsive 3-column grid of genre checkboxes with toggle support, disabled state, and a fallback message when no genres are available.
frontend/src/components/manga/MANGA_LIST: A manual QA checklist for verifying MangaListPage layout correctness across row alignment, overflow behavior, loading/error/empty states, pagination, and multiple viewport sizes.
Displays a single manga entry as a styled card with cover image, title cycling, chapter progress editing, bookmark toggle, notes hover overlay, and a cover popup.
frontend/src/components/manga/MangaListC: Provides a control bar for the manga list with search, sort, completion status filter, bookmark toggle, genre checkboxes, alignment toggle, and an add-manga button.
frontend/src/components/manga/MangaListP: Main page component that fetches all manga entries, applies search/genre/bookmark/completion filters and sorting, paginates results, and renders rows with uniform width via a floating controls panel.
frontend/src/components/manga/MangaRowAc: Wraps a MangaCard with edit, notes, and delete action buttons, and conditionally renders EditMangaDialog and EditNotesDialog modals.
frontend/src/components/manga/NotesPrevi: Renders a portal-based tooltip overlay that displays manga notes text positioned below a given anchor element's bounding rect.
frontend/src/components/manga/Pagination: React component that renders pagination controls with previous/next buttons, numbered page buttons with ellipsis truncation, and a jump-to-page input form.
frontend/src/context/BackendConnectionCo: React context provider that creates a single shared backend connection instance for the app, exposing it via a custom hook to prevent multiple competing connection loops.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated identities, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithRetry.ts: Thin wrapper around the singleton backend connection hook that re-exposes connection state fields with actor-retry-oriented naming.
frontend/src/hooks/useAllMangaEntries.ts: Hook that fetches all manga entries from the backend and caches them in both IndexedDB and localStorage, falling back to cached data on fetch errors.
Core hook that manages backend actor initialization and readiness with timeouts, bounded auto-retries, session generation for stale-attempt protection, and detailed diagnostic state.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendConnectionS: Thin hook that delegates to the BackendConnectionContext to provide access to the singleton backend connection state.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendReadiness.t: Hook that maps the singleton backend connection state to a readiness-oriented interface with status, error, and retry fields.
frontend/src/hooks/useCachedCoverImageUr: Hook that returns a cover image URL preferring a cached IndexedDB blob, falling back to the network URL while asynchronously fetching and caching the image.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks for fetching and saving the current user's profile via the backend actor, with automatic user-role assignment on first access and query invalidation on save.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence via AuthClient, and exposing status flags like isLoggingIn and isLoginSuccess.
frontend/src/hooks/useLibraryGenres.ts: Custom hook that derives a sorted, deduplicated list of genres from all manga entries in the library.
frontend/src/hooks/useMangaMutations.ts: Provides TanStack Query mutation hooks for manga CRUD operations (add, update, rating, bookmark, notes) against the backend actor, invalidating relevant query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/usePersistentPopupPos: Hook that manages a draggable popup's position, persisting it to localStorage and clamping it within the viewport on load and window resize.
frontend/src/hooks/useUniformWatchlistRo: Hook that measures and synchronizes the maximum scroll width across registered row elements, re-measuring on resize, image load, and dependency changes to enforce uniform row widths.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining a black-and-gold dark theme via CSS custom properties, Tailwind base layers, custom fonts (Cinzel, Crimson Text), and utility animations including a rainbow color-shift keyframe.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/sw/registerServiceWorker.ts: Utility functions to register a service worker on page load and to send a cache-clear message to an active service worker, awaiting confirmation.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrorClassific: Classifies backend errors into categories (connecting, transient, authorization, application, timeout) with user-friendly messages and retry guidance. Also exports a helper to check if an error is retryable.
frontend/src/utils/backendNotReadyMessag: Provides a shared constant for the backend-not-ready error message and an assertion helper that throws that error if the backend actor is unavailable.
frontend/src/utils/formatChapterNumber.t: Exports a single utility function that formats a chapter number as a string, omitting unnecessary decimal points for whole numbers.
frontend/src/utils/indexedDb.ts: Opens a shared IndexedDB database (MangaWatchlistDB) and provides generic CRUD helpers (get, put, delete, getAllKeys) for the mangaMetadata and coverImages object stores.
frontend/src/utils/offlineCoverImageInde: Implements an IndexedDB-backed cache for cover image blobs, keyed by principal, manga stableId, and a URL hash, with helpers to get, store, fetch-and-cache, and clear images per principal.
frontend/src/utils/offlineMangaCache.ts: Provides a legacy localStorage-based cache for manga entries, serializing/deserializing BigInt fields and versioning the stored data.
frontend/src/utils/offlineMangaIndexedDb: Implements a per-principal IndexedDB cache for manga entry metadata, with versioned serialization/deserialization of BigInt fields and helpers to read, write, and clear entries.
frontend/src/utils/promiseTimeout.ts: Provides utilities to wrap a promise with a hard timeout (withTimeout) and to create a standalone rejecting timeout promise (createTimeout), both using a custom TimeoutError class.
frontend/src/utils/retryBackoff.ts: Implements bounded exponential backoff with jitter for retrying async operations, including a standalone retryWithBackoff function and a RetryManager class for manual retry control.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts (Cinzel, Crimson Text), a gold/dark color palette with oklch CSS variables, custom shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations including rainbow and scroll effects.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for MangaList, a single-user manga watchlist app on ICP with Internet Identity auth, documenting existing features, a pending multi-user access control fix request, and known cycle depletion issues.
